question.text: Which SAS standard covers 'Ensuring environmental sustainability, addressing climate change including mitigation and adaptation, forest, and wildlife conservation'?

explanation.text: The Logic: Section 5.5 maps SAS 500 to environmental sustainability / climate change / forest and wildlife conservation. SAS 200 is healthcare/sanitation/water; SAS 400 is gender; SAS 1200 is disaster management. The Trap: SAS 200 (A) is the healthcare standard — common confusion because environmental health sanitation overlaps. SAS 400 (B) is gender. SAS 1200 (D) is disaster management, which touches climate adaptation but is distinct. Cross-Exam Context: XXIII uniquely tests SAS numbering. Climate/environment also appears thematically in NISM III-A (ESG under BRSR) but without SAS mapping. Assessor's Pro-Tip: For SAS 500 engagements that use satellite imagery for forest-cover MoV, triangulate with village-level encroachment registers and ground-truthing photos — solo reliance on NDVI data has been a material qualification trigger in ICAI SIAB reviews.
